newsitem.title: SPAIN: SEPI to finalise Inespal sale to Alcoa next week.
newsitem.headline: SEPI to finalise Inespal sale to Alcoa next week.

text.p: Spain's state holding company SEPI is set to sign a deal next week to sell aluminium group Inespal to the Aluminum Company of America (Alcoa), Industry Minister Josep Pique said.
"I anticipate with all probability that SEPI will sign the sale next week ... of 100 percent of Inespal to Alcoa," Pique told a news conference after the government's regular weekly Cabinet meeting.
Last February, Alcoa and SEPI signed a letter of intent to acquire the main sectors of the aluminium business of Inespal for an undisclosed price before the end of 1997.
The sale includes an alumina refinery, three aluminium smelters, aluminium rolling, foil and extrusion businesses and related facilities.
Inespal is an integrated aluminium producer with revenues of $1.1 billion in 1996.
